en: The image shows a vintage scene of a public square with several people, mostly children, scattered across a rocky, parklike setting. There are traditional wooden houses in the background with red and gray roofs. The scene gives a calm neighborhood or small public gathering spot from the past, with several leafy trees framing the area. The text at the top identifies the location, and official museum attribution appears at the bottom.
